excerpts.text: **Guadalupe Peak**, also known as **Signal Peak**,[[3]](#cite_note-3) is the highest natural point in [Texas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas "Texas"),[[4]](#cite_note-4) with an elevation of 8,751 feet (2,667 m) above [sea level](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sea_level "Sea level").[[1]](#cite_note-ngs-1) It is located in [Guadalupe Mountains National Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guadalupe_Mountains_National_Park "Guadalupe Mountains National Park"), and is part of the [Guadalupe Mountains](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guadalupe_Mountains "Guadalupe Mountains") range in southeastern [New Mexico](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Mexico "New Mexico") and [West Texas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Texas "West Texas"). The mountain is about 90 miles (140 km) east of [El Paso](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/El_Paso "El Paso") and about 50 miles (80 km) southwest of [Carlsbad, New Mexico](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carlsbad,_New_Mexico "Carlsbad, New Mexico"). The peak rises more than 3,000 feet (910 m) above the arid floor of the [Chihuahuan Desert](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chihuahuan_Desert "Chihuahuan Desert").
